title: Olagbegi Atanneye II
content:
Olagbegi Atanneye II was a paramount ruler of Owo Kingdom, Ondo state, southwestern Nigeria and the father of Olagbegi Atanneye I and Olowo Ajike Ogunoye. 


== Early life ==
Olagbegi Atanneye II was born in Owo, Ondo State, and served as the traditional paramount ruler of Owo Kingdom. He succeeded his father, Olagbegi Atanneye I, as well as Olowo Ajike Ogunoye.
